title: Nasty Juice Modmate Red Rage Shortfill 50ml E-Liquid
description: Red Rage by Mod Mate from Nasty Juice captures the sweet, bubbly refreshment of your favourite energy drink to perfection. Tangy, yet light and refreshing and deliciously fruity, Red Rage is an invigorating flavour with endless appeal. Red Rage Mod Mate shortfill e-liquid by Nasty Juice is a fizzy drink-inspired blend that replicates the flavour of the classic energy drink for a bold and fruity vape. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks. Shortfill e-liquids are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and who always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities. Since their high-VG to PG ratio typically makes them suitable for use with high-powered devices, such vape kits often consume e-liquid faster than low-powered vape devices, so having a large bottle of your favourite e-liquid helps ensure you don’t run out too quickly. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Juice Mod Mate flavours to try. Mod Mate are specially formulated freebase e-liquids that Nasty Juice have fine-tuned for optimised performance with all leading vape mod devices, as part of their ENDS collection. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and are available in 50ml shortfills for use with high-powered mods and pod kits. Make your mod your mate, with Mod Mate from Nasty Juice E-liquids.
